_note: Sourced makeup-water quality for the 14 study sites and citable treatment limit sets. See docs/WATER_QUALITY_SOURCES.md for conversions, confidence and gaps. Units mg/L; hardness and alkalinity as CaCO3; silica as SiO2. null = not reported/not found. Keys listed in a site's 'estimated' are estimates, not measured values.

atlanta.description: Atlanta DWM (Chattahoochee R.). Utility CCR 2025 has no mineral data; values are USGS NWIS raw-river medians at 02336000 Chattahoochee R. at Atlanta (Ca, alk, SiO2, Cl, SO4: 1995-2009, n=2); TDS = median specific conductance 2010-2024 (76 uS/cm, n=306) x 0.65. Treated water is likely somewhat higher in Ca/alkalinity (lime/caustic) and sulfate (coagulant).

dallas.description: Dallas Water Utilities (Elm Fork Trinity / Lewisville, Ray Roberts, Grapevine, Ray Hubbard, Tawakoni). DWU 2025 CCR has no mineral data; values are USGS NWIS raw-water medians at 08053000 Elm Fork Trinity R. nr Lewisville, 1985-1997 (n~70). Alternative East Fork (Ray Hubbard, 08061750): Ca 51.5, alk 115, SiO2 7.9, Cl 45, SO4 51, TDS 302.

houston.description: City of Houston Main System (~90% surface water, Lake Houston/Trinity). Cl, SO4, TDS, pH = 2025 CCR averages (total hardness avg 135.5, range 43.5-229). Ca hardness, alkalinity, SiO2 not in CCR -> USGS NWIS medians at 08066500 Trinity R. at Romayor 1985-1995 (Ca 39 mg/L x 2.497).

las_vegas.description: LVVWD (Lake Mead / Colorado R.) 2026 Water Quality Summary annual averages. Ca 75 mg/L x 2.497; alkalinity 137 mg/L as HCO3 x 0.82. 2024 summary: Ca 79, Cl 104, SiO2 7.6, SO4 235, TDS 642.

phoenix_tmyx.description: Phoenix, CAP (Colorado R.) supply assumed for a data center (west/north Phoenix plants). USGS NWIS medians at 09427520 Colorado R. below Parker Dam (CAP intake reach), 2005-2023 (n~50; SiO2 n=4). Consistent with City of Phoenix 2025 CCR distribution ranges: total hardness 172-302, alkalinity 121-167, TDS 464-716, pH 6.6-8.8. Alternative SRP Salt/Verde water: higher Na/Cl and TDS (up to ~700), not quantified.

portland_or.description: Portland Water Bureau, 100% Bull Run (test-results page, updated Jul 2026). Total hardness 7; Ca ~1.9 mg/L x 2.497 (unconfirmed secondary table); silica 3.8 mg/L as Si x 2.139. Cl and SO4 not reported. Alternative Columbia South Shore groundwater: hardness 68, alk 91, SiO2 40.6 (19 as Si), TDS 125, pH 8.2.

montreal.description: Ville de Montreal (Atwater + Charles-J.-Des Baillets, St. Lawrence), distributed water 2022 annual mean (min-max): Ca 30.9 (28-33) mg/L x 2.497; alkalinity 93 (87-96); SiO2 1.07; Cl 25.8; SO4 21.5; conductivity 306 uS/cm; LSI -0.46. TDS = conductivity x 0.65 (report 'solides totaux' 146, 'solides fixes' 180 are inconsistent).

dublin.description: Uisce Eireann Ballymore Eustace (Liffey) supply, largest Dublin source; parameter guide values (dlrcoco 2013): Ca 18-20 mg/L (x 2.497 -> 45-50), total hardness 55, alkalinity 28, Cl <25, SO4 <35 (upper bounds used), TDS 95, pH 7.5-8.5. Silica not reported. Alternative Leixlip (harder; Ca hardness 100-250, alk 70-200; low-confidence council replies).
dublin.confidence: medium (guide values; Cl/SO4 are upper bounds)

frankfurt.description: Mainova/Hessenwasser Frankfurt: blend of soft (Vogelsberg/Spessart) and hard (Hessisches Ried) waters. Ca 68.0 and SO4 44.8 = 2019 city-wide annual means (Ca x 2.497). Alkalinity, Cl, TDS, pH = linear mix of 2018 Innenstadt soft/hard analyses with hard fraction 0.56 implied by the Ca mean (soft: Ks4.3 1.0-1.6 mmol/L, Cl 8, cond 194; hard: Ks4.3 5.1 mmol/L, Cl 32, cond 703 uS/cm); alkalinity = Ks4.3 x 50; TDS = cond x 0.65. SiO2 ~18 in both waters (reported as SiO2).

madrid.description: Canal de Isabel II (Sierra granite reservoirs; very soft, low conductivity per Ayuntamiento de Madrid). No utility table found. Ca 16 mg/L (x 2.497), total hardness 55, TDS ~90 from tapwaterscan.com (secondary, uncited, updated 2026). Alkalinity ESTIMATE = 40 mg/L as CaCO3 (assumed ~ Ca+Mg hardness for Ca-HCO3 granite water; no source). SiO2, Cl, SO4 not found.

stockholm.description: Stockholm Vatten och Avfall, Norsborg (Lake Malaren), 2024 annual averages at Haninge receiving point: Ca 26 mg/L x 2.497; total hardness 4.7 dH (84 as CaCO3); Cl 16; SO4 44; conductivity 25 mS/m -> TDS x 0.65; pH 8.2. Alkalinity ~55 mg/L HCO3 x 0.82 (2019 declaration). Silica not reported. Lovo plant (same lake) assumed similar.

riyadh.description: Riyadh distribution network (desalinated Jubail water ~2/3 blended with treated groundwater ~1/3). Ca 58.6, Cl 120, SO4 88.5, TDS 396, pH 7.88 = means of 15 network sites sampled 2020, Aleid et al. (2023) Arabian J. Chem. 17:105431 (Ca x 2.497). Alkalinity not reported: ESTIMATE 80 mg/L as CaCO3 = upper end of SWA mandated desal-water range 50-80 (Fellows & Al-Hamzah 2026, Table 2); blend may be higher. Silica not reported.

mumbai.description: MCGM/BMC (Vaitarna, Bhatsa, Tansa reservoirs; Bhandup/Panjrapur WTPs). No utility ion data found. Total hardness 46.8 (soft), alkalinity 97.3, Cl 9.5, pH 7.0-7.5 from an MSc study of Mumbai tap water (academia.edu, read via search snippet only). Ca hardness ESTIMATE = 0.75 x total hardness. TDS ESTIMATE 120 (no source; 2019 BIS survey: all Mumbai samples met IS 10500, i.e. TDS <500). SiO2, SO4 not found.

singapore.description: PUB potable water (waterworks + desalination), Jan-Dec 2025 averages (ranges): Ca 15.5 (2.8-74.6) mg/L x 2.497; total hardness 42.7; alkalinity 35 (7-68); SiO2 1.23 (0.17-7.4); Cl 30 (<5-167); SO4 7.2; TDS 116 (63-542); pH 8.0 (7.5-8.9). Alternative: NEWater (industrial; Ca <20, hardness <50, Cl <20, SiO2 <3 upper limits).

evapco_galvanized_inhibitor.description: Conventional scale/corrosion inhibitor, no acid, galvanized (G-235) tower. Limits = EVAPCO TWR19AOM (2019) p.18 Table 3 galvanized column: SiO2 <150, Ca hardness 50-500, alkalinity 75-400, Cl <300, conductivity <2400 uS/cm (TDS = x0.65), pH 7.0-8.8. LSI <= 2.0 for polyacrylate/phosphonate inhibitors (Bhatia, PDHonline M324 p.11). ph_cycled 8.5 = ASSUMED natural cycled pH without acid (within EVAPCO 7.0-8.8). Sulfate: no EVAPCO limit.

icc_advanced_inhibitor.description: Modern polymer/stabilizer program, no acid, galvanized tower <=43.3 C. Limits = ICC GEW174-14 (EVAPCO proposal to IgCC 703.7.7) Table 703.7.7: LSI 2.8, Ca 800, M-alk 500, SiO2 150, Cl 300, SO4 250, conductivity 4000 uS/cm (TDS = x0.65), stop at 10 cycles. ph_cycled 8.5 ASSUMED.

acid_feed_ph7p5.description: Acid feed with recirculating pH controlled at 7.5 (CED Engineering course: pH control 7-8) plus stabilizer. Alkalinity is destroyed by acid, so no M-alk limit; SiO2 <= 200 at pH < 7.5 (Demadis 2003, Chemical Processing); Ca 800, Cl 300, conductivity 4000 (ICC GEW174-14); LSI <= 2.8 (ICC) evaluated at pH 7.5. NOTE: chemistry.py scales alkalinity with N in the LSI, which overstates LSI under acid feed (conservative), and does not add sulfate from H2SO4 dosing, so no sulfate limit is applied.

bac_galvanized.description: BAC circulating-water guidelines, galvanized steel (Baltibond product sheet PRD1201v04EN p.2): pH 6.5-9.0, total hardness 50-600 (applied here to Ca hardness: lenient), alkalinity <=500, TDS <=1500, Cl <=250, SO4 <=250 (Cl+SO4 <=500 alternative not modelled), conductivity 2400. BAC gives no silica limit; EVAPCO 150 used for silica. LSI/pH: as evapco_galvanized_inhibitor.

evapco_stainless316.description: 316 stainless tower (EVAPCO TWR19AOM Table 3): pH 6.0-9.5, conductivity <5000 (TDS x0.65), alkalinity <600, Ca hardness <600, Cl <2000, SiO2 <150; LSI 2.8 (ICC) with stabilizer, ph_cycled 8.5 ASSUMED.
